item_name: Patient Review Instrument Invalid Resident not on site for the look back period

lookback_source.quote: If the Patient Review Instrument applicable for the claim under review is dated while the patient is not in the facility on that date or the 7 days prior, the claim will be disallowed.

lookback_notes: The protocol's audit criteria state the look-back period as the PRI date plus the 7 days prior to that date; the resident must be in the facility during that window. The document titles this window "the look back period" but does not otherwise define how days are counted.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If the Patient Review Instrument applicable for the claim under review is dated while the patient is not in the facility on that date or the 7 days prior, the claim will be disallowed.

federal.criterion: The record must support that the resident was in the facility on the PRI date or within the 7 days prior to that date.

source.quote: If the Patient Review Instrument applicable for the claim under review is dated while the patient is not in the facility on that date or the 7 days prior, the claim will be disallowed.

federal.notes: Stated as the OMIG Audit Criteria for disallowance; the document does not name specific source documents used to evidence on-site presence.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The Area 30 entry does not tie this finding to a payment/case-mix classification. (A separate finding, Area 29 Incorrect PRI Level Claimed, addresses PRI level and payment, but that is a different item.)
